summary: Recorded the participant-eligibility consequence of the configuration gap from the retained receipt 666f0626e67340a491ab414403fd1e6b: the node's recovered set held three voters while the configuration in force listed five (event 28), and its vote was refused for the candidate the configuration in force contains but the recovered set does not, while the identical request from a candidate inside the recovered set was granted (event 29, predicate violated). Because both requests carried the leadership-transfer flag and matched in term and log recency, the refusal is attributable to the membership rule alone; the account states the bounded election-liveness consequence against the repair path and adds a behavior entry.
